title: Desirable Cities sentence annotation, v1.0.0
description: One record per sentence of a Wikipedia commune article. A sentence can carry several environments (natural, cultural, constructural) and several responses (emotion, action, reflection). A PID cell is an environment x response pair that the sentence links together (Cities' PIDs, thesis §16.4, p. 270). Category definitions and keywords: schema/lexicon_v0.yaml.

sentence_id.description: <insee>-<langue>-<revision_id>-s<index>, index = position of the sentence in the article (0-based).

insee.description: INSEE code, always text (2A/2B for Corsica).

section_type.description: Common section type shared across languages.

environments.description: Environments the sentence refers to. Empty array = none.

responses.description: Responses the sentence reports or attributes to people. Empty array = the sentence only describes what is there.

pid_cells.description: Environment x response pairs linked by the sentence. Each pair must use an environment and a response present above.

public_space_types.description: The nine open-air public-space types of ch. 15.4 (p. 255) named in the sentence.

register.description: descriptive = neutral statement; imaginary = shared narrative, legend, nickname (Silva); spectacle = branding, labels, rankings (Debord).

uncertain.description: true when the annotator cannot decide; the record is then reviewed.

evidence.description: Exact span of the sentence that justifies the label (copied verbatim).

tag.description: Koinos-style tag from the lexicon: <category>.<subcategory>[.<term>], e.g. natural.water_features.river, emotion.koinos_emotions.calm.

id.description: Human initials, or method name (e.g. lexicon_v0, deepseek-chat).

model_version.description: Exact model version for LLM or embedding runs.
